bounded_checks.findings: Replaced the 'restrictive end repair' step (not a source operation) with the source workflow: 50:50 AMPure binding, on-bead HpyCH4V (TG^CA, blunt 5'-CA ends) 37C 15min, 2.5x AMPure, Klenow exo- A-tailing with equimolar dATP/ddBTPs 37C 30min, xGen Duplex Seq Adapter (IDT 1080799) T4 ligation 20C 20min, 1x AMPure, KAPA qPCR with NanoqPCR1/2 on 1:500 aliquot, dilution bottleneck (~0.3 fmol, r_opt 5.1), NEBNext Ultra II Q5 PCR with unprinted UDI primers (10-16 cycles), 2x0.7x AMPure, 150PE. Added ddBTP-terminated nick-extension candidate off-product with unresolved (not physically removed, unamplifiable) fate. Known cohesive ligation geometry: dA tail vs adapter NNN-T 3' overhang (AM 'T is the adapter overhang'). Final library now NNN UMI(A)-T-CA..TG-A-nnn UMI(B) with umi features; TruSeq-type shell, P5/P7 and 8-nt indices marked inferred (qPCR primers match TruSeq Read1/Read2 arm bases) with page caveat; spacer base not drawn. Removed the unused parallel spec workflow. AM 'Supplementary Note 3' vs published Note 4 for ddBTPs recorded as version numbering, not a discrepancy. Added AM row to external MANIFEST.tsv.
